outcome: Understand individual words, phrases and sentences in unseen Biblical Hebrew passages.
Identify the overall message, key points and details of a passage.
Deduce and infer meaning from more complex information.
Know the prescribed Biblical Hebrew vocabulary list.
Translate unseen passages into idiomatic English that shows awareness of morphology and syntax.
Show understanding of Biblical Hebrew grammatical structures and terminology.
Translate simple English sentences into pointed Biblical Hebrew with standard word order, using the restricted vocabulary and grammar.
Translate set text passages into idiomatic English with awareness of morphology and syntax.
Know the background of events, characters and places, and locate important places on maps.
Identify key grammatical forms, derived nouns and proper noun derivations in the texts.
Study Genesis 41-43, Joseph's rise to power.
Study Kings 4-7, the miracles of Elisha.
Study I Samuel 8-11 and 13, the start of the monarchy under Saul.
Study II Kings 18-23, Hezekiah and Manasseh.
Analyse literary style: word choice, word order, imagery, parallelism and oath language.
Give up to two explanations of complex, ambiguous or uncommon words, with contextual or grammatical support.
Analyse and evaluate themes, significant events, relationships and characters.
Compare and contrast ideas, values and social practices across both texts.
Select relevant evidence to compare content and literary style, and evaluate its significance.
Form nouns by gender, number and state, including irregular nouns, and nouns with preformatives mem, aleph and tav.
Make adjectives agree, form comparatives and superlatives, and use cardinal and ordinal numbers.
Attach pronominal suffixes to nouns, verbs and prepositions.
Handle weak verb roots and all persons and numbers of the perfect and imperfect.
Recognise the pluperfect in narrative, the imperative, cohortative and qal participles as verbs.
Form qal, niphal, piel, hiphil and hithpael, and recognise common hophal and pual forms.
Handle irregular verb types: pe-nun, pe-yod, ayin-vav, lamed-he, pe and ayin guttural, and geminate.
Use the infinitive construct with prefixes and the infinitive absolute.
Use inseparable prepositions, "from", the definite article, interrogative he, vav conjunctive and vav consecutive.
Use the gentilic yod and locative he.
Apply pointing rules: syllables, vowels, sheva, hataf, dagesh, and effects of gutturals and labials.
Recognise relative, conditional, temporal, concessive, causal, purpose and result clauses.
Recognise verbless, asseverative, negative, oath and interrogative clauses.
Use correct grammatical terms for nouns, adjectives, pronouns and verbs, such as construct form, root, tense and geminate.
